text: I know that you deserve the best, fine wine and cuisine. Top of the line, designer things to be with the navigational screen. Pounds of purple and green, footwear to switch up daily for weeks. You told me you love diamonds, fine, open your mind. Cause if I could, I'd throw you a whole coal mine. Through my gray skies, you're my rays of sunshine. And I don't have to worry about you crying the one time. Cause not only are you classy and sassy, but the streets is in your bloodstream. You get your grizzly on for the green.
